name: Filozofia - základy B2
description: Odborná anglická slovná zásoba z oblasti filozofie
author: doc. Jana Nováková, PhD.

words.definition: A strong feeling that something is true or real, often without complete proof.

contextSentences.en: A justified true belief was long considered the standard definition of knowledge until Gettier challenged it.
Philosophers distinguish between a belief one holds and a belief one is rationally entitled to hold.

words.example_en: Her belief in moral responsibility led her to reject the philosopher's claim that all human actions are determined.
words.example_sk: Jej presvedčenie o morálnej zodpovednosti ju viedlo k tomu, že odmietla filozofovo tvrdenie, že všetky ľudské činy sú predurčené.

words.definition: The idea, sense, or significance that a word, action, text, or life itself conveys or is understood to have.

contextSentences.en: According to Viktor Frankl, the search for meaning is the deepest driving force in human life.
Camus argued that life has no inherent meaning, but that we can create our own.

words.example_en: In the seminar, the students argued that the meaning of justice changes when we examine it from Aristotle’s perspective.
words.example_sk: Na seminári študenti tvrdili, že význam spravodlivosti sa mení, keď ju skúmame z Aristotelovej perspektívy.
